Package grpcdc

Class Channel.ClientStream

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.Channel.ClientStream
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Enclosing class:
Channel
public static final class Channel.ClientStream extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Receives response messages of one call. Closing the stream (try-with-resources) abandons a still-live call with RST CANCELLED so the server stops producing; a call that already terminated just closes locally.
